scores.notes: Peter leaping from the boat (left) and the standing man in the brown cloak holding the net (right) both have short dark curly hair flecked with grey, a short greying beard, a weathered middle-aged face and the same brown cloak.

Both show the same plank-built wooden boat with a patched cream sail, rope-bound stern post and a sack cushion in the stern, on a dark lake under storm cloud with low green hills on the far shore; only the storm easing differs, which the passages ask for.

Same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a rope-wrapped mast on a grey-blue lake ringed by low hills under storm cloud; the left shows no sail where the right has a torn one, but the lake, shoreline and boat build are compatible and the calm is the requested change.

Left shows the sea starting to open along a wet sandy, rock-strewn bed from a rocky shore; right shows the same wet sand corridor between teal walls of water, both under the same heavy dark storm sky with a pale break at the horizon.

Both show a wet, muddy seabed path opening through dark green-grey breaking water under a black storm sky; the left adds the near shore with palms and a distant walled town, the right the far red cliffs, which are compatible views of one crossing.
Both show a wet sandy seabed corridor between curling blue-green walls of water leading back to the same red flat-topped desert cliffs under a pale cloudy sky.

Both show the same puddled, rock-strewn sandy seabed between towering blue-green water walls receding to a far shore; the left sky is darker and its far hills grey where the right shows red mesas, but the corridor itself matches and the far end is mostly hidden by spray on the left.

Daniel in the den (left) and Daniel holding the rope (right) are both an older man with short grey hair and a short grey beard in a blue outer robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder satchel; the right figure is small and reads a shade lighter in skin, but no clear cue conflicts.

The house behind the table is a stone and half-timbered Tudor cottage with tall chimneys on the left but a pale clapboard Victorian house with a columned porch on the right, and the table is bare wood on the left but covered with a white cloth on the right.

Both show a dry, pale dirt track through olive-dotted hill country with flat-roofed pale stone houses and a cypress; the left is the wide view down the road toward the farmstead, the right a close view in front of such a house, which fits together.

Moses with the crook staff is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, a lean weathered face and a dark brown cloak over a cream tunic in both; his hair and beard look shorter and neater in the left crowd view than in the windblown right, but colour, age and build agree.

Both show the same wet ochre sandy seabed with scattered rocks and seaweed running between rising blue-green water; the right is the near sandy shore with palms under a darker sky as the sea opens, the left the corridor looking back to desert cliffs, which are compatible views.

Daniel on the rope (left) and Daniel standing among the lions (right) share short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older face and the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a strap case; his skin only looks darker on the right because of the den's shadow.

Both show a calm pale lake at early light ringed by the same tan, terraced hills with olive and cypress, a low stony shore with a small smoking fire and a wooden fishing boat close in; the right adds palms and reeds seen from the water side, which is compatible.

Both show a sandy corridor through curling green sea leading back to pale sand dunes on the far shore; the left is seen from higher up so the water walls look lower and the ground drier and rockier, and the right adds red cliffs beside the dunes, but the layout is compatible.
Jesus crouching at the fire (left) and standing in the boat (right) both have shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face and a cream tunic under a blue-grey mantle.

The tables under the big tree are alike, but the house behind is a pale plastered Georgian-style house with sash windows and a pedimented doorway on the left and a red-brick half-timbered Tudor house with leaded windows on the right.

Both show an ochre sand path opening through the same green, white-capped sea under grey storm cloud, with sandy rock-strewn ground and pale desert hills behind; the left is the near shore as the water starts to divide, the right the corridor further in.

Both show a pale sandy, rock-strewn shore and seabed against dark blue-green breaking sea under storm cloud; the right is the darker night view from the shore with palms before the path fully opens, which the passage's night wind accounts for, and nothing in the land conflicts.
Moses with the crook staff is in both an elderly man with swept-back white hair, a long full white beard, the same lined tanned face and a brown cloak over a belted cream tunic.

Both show a grey pebble shore with a small cooking fire at the edge of a wide lake backed by low dark hills with reeds and scrub; the left looks toward a hillside village in warmer breaking light and the right along a darker stretch of the bank, which is compatible.
Both show a ridged and furrowed green lawn enclosed by a low brick garden wall with clipped shrubs and tall trees behind, card-soldier hoops and hedgehogs on the grass, in the same soft daylight.

Both show a plank-built wooden boat with a single mast and cream square sail on a dark, white-capped lake under storm cloud with steep hilly shores behind; the stern post is curled on the right and plain on the left, a small difference against the matching boat, water and shoreline.

Daniel beside the angel (left) and Daniel being lifted from the pit (right) both have short grey hair, a short trimmed grey beard, a lean older brown-skinned face and the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a strap pouch.

Both show an uneven ridged lawn bounded by a garden wall with hedges and tall leafy trees, card soldiers bent as hoops and hedgehogs on the grass, in the same daylight; the ridges are drawn more strongly on the right but the garden is compatible.

Daniel climbing the rope (left) and Daniel standing among the lions (right) both have short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older brown-skinned face and the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a waist pouch.

Peter standing with the net by the fire (left) and Peter jumping from the boat (right) both have thick dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short grey-flecked beard, a sturdy middle-aged build and a rough brown cloak.

The house behind the table is a pale plastered house with sash windows and a pedimented door on the left but a red-brick, half-timbered tiled cottage with a gabled porch on the right, and the table has a patterned cloth on the left and is bare wood on the right.

The house is a thatched, half-timbered cottage with a rose-covered doorway on the left but a grey weatherboarded house with a columned veranda on the right; the tree and cloth-covered table are alike but the building conflicts.

Both show a rough, tufted green lawn inside a long pinkish brick garden wall with conifers and leafy trees behind under a pale cloudy sky; the hoops are white arches on the left and bent soldiers on the right, but the ground, wall and planting are compatible.

The left den is a dark vaulted chamber whose walls close in to a small round opening with a barred window, while the right is a straight-walled circular pit fully open to the sky across its whole width with a wooden lid and gate at ground level; the floor is bare sand on the left and straw on the right.

Daniel standing among the lions (left) and Daniel held by the soldiers in the pit (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, an older lean face and the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder pouch; the right figure is smaller but shows no conflicting cue.

Both show a rough lawn inside a brick garden wall with clipped hedges, cypresses and broad leafy trees, card soldiers bent as hoops and hedgehogs on the grass in daylight; the furrows are drawn more strongly on the right but the garden is compatible.

Both show an ochre sandy seabed with seaweed, shells and rock outcrops running through green white-crested sea beside reddish desert cliffs; the left is the dark night view as the sea begins to divide, which the passage's night wind asks for, and the right the open corridor in daylight.

Both show a ridged, furrowed green lawn enclosed by a long red-brick garden wall with leafy trees overhanging and tall trees beyond under a cloudy daytime sky; the hoops are arched cards on the left and soldiers on the right, but the ground itself matches.

Both show the same kind of plank-built wooden boat with a rope-bound mast and raised stern post on a grey-green lake with green terraced hills on the right-hand shore under storm cloud; the left shows no sail where the right has a torn one, but the lake and shore match and the calming is the requested change.

Both show a wet, rocky brown seabed with seaweed and pools running between teal white-crested water under the same black storm sky with a pale break at the horizon; the right is the cliff-backed shore as the sea opens and the left the corridor further in.

Both show a ridged, striped green lawn enclosed by a low brick garden wall with rounded shrubs in front and tall leafy trees behind, card soldiers bent as hoops and hedgehogs on the grass in the same soft daylight.

Peter plunging through the water in the brown cloak (left) and the standing man in the rough brown cloak holding the net (right) both have short dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short grey-flecked beard and a weathered middle-aged face.

Both show the same dark plank-built boat with a rope-bound mast, coiled ropes and a cushion in the stern on a black-green, white-capped lake under storm cloud; the left is a closer, darker view with no shore in frame and the right shows steep dark hills, which does not conflict.

Both show a long tea table on grass under a large spreading tree in front of a pale weatherboarded house with a posted porch and shrubs around; the table is bare wood on the left and cloth-covered on the right, but the house, tree and garden agree.

Both show the same plank-built wooden boat with a rope-bound stern post and cushion in the stern on a dark blue-green, white-capped lake in driving rain with green scrubby hills on the shore; the left mast is bare where the right carries a patched sail, a small difference against the matching water, shore and boat.

Both show pale flat-roofed stone houses with low dry-stone walls on a dusty pale track among olive trees and cypresses, backed by the same terraced tan-green hills under a clear daytime sky; the left is the approach road and the right the yard in front of the houses.

Both show a wet brown sandy seabed running through teal white-crested sea under heavy storm cloud; the right is the dark near shore with palms and a town as the water begins to divide, which the passage's night wind asks for, and the left looks along the open corridor to red cliffs on the far side.

Both show a deep round pit lined with large grey ashlar blocks and topped by a low parapet where the king stands, with pale fortress stonework behind and daylight coming in from above; the right view from the floor shows part of an arch overhead not seen from the left, but the open-topped stone pit is compatible.

Both show a rough tufted lawn enclosed by the same long pinkish brick wall with dark cypresses and rounded leafy trees behind under a pale cloudy sky; hoops are white arches on the left and bent soldiers on the right, but the garden itself matches.

Taking Peter on the left as the dripping-wet man in the brown cloak by the fire, his curly hair is mostly dark with a dark greying beard, while Peter leaping from the boat on the right has plainly grey curly hair and a grey-white beard and looks a decade older.

Moses with the staff is in both an elderly man with white hair, a long full white beard, a tanned lined face and a dark brown cloak over a belted cream tunic; he is smaller in the right crowd view but no cue conflicts.

Both show pale flat-roofed stone houses with dry-stone walls on a dusty pale track among olive trees, backed by the same dry terraced hills in clear daylight; the left is the road leading up to the farmstead and the right the yard in front of it.

Both show the same plank-built wooden boat with a rope-bound stern post on a dark blue-green lake under storm cloud with steep scrubby hills along the shore; the left carries a patched sail where the right mast is bare, but the lake and shoreline match and the calming is the requested change.

Jesus standing in the boat (left) and crouching at the fire (right) both have shoulder-length dark brown hair parted in the middle, a short dark beard, the same lean face and a cream tunic under a blue-grey mantle.
